title: INSPECTION OF UPPER FRONT VALVE BODY / ASSEMBLY OF UPPER FRONT VALVE BODY

content.text: INSPECTION OF UPPER FRONT VALVE BODY
Check for damage, squareness, rust and collapsed coils. Measure the spring free height and replace if less than that shown below.

content.description: Exploded view of upper front valve body showing locations of (1) Secondary regulator valve, (2) Down-shift plug, (3) Throttle valve, and (4) Cut-back valve with springs

content.text: ASSEMBLY OF UPPER FRONT VALVE BODY
Note arrangement in the figure. Make sure that the valve is inserted fully into the bore.

content.description: Two hand illustrations showing insertion of throttle valve into valve body bore

content.text: Coat the retainer with petroleum jelly to keep it in place. Note position of tabs in the figure. Slip the retainer into place in the valve body.
3.   INSTALL ADJUSTING RINGS AND SMALL SPRING ON THROTTLE VALVE SHAFT

items: (a) Install the same number of adjusting rings as were removed during disassembly.
(b) Slip the spring onto the valve shaft. Compress and slide into place.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of adjusting ring onto throttle valve shaft

items: (a) Push the down-shift plug into the bore.
(b) Coat the pin with petroleum jelly and install it to hold the sleeve.

content.description: Two illustrations showing insertion of spring and down-shift plug, and installation of retaining pin
